reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I was buying Purina for the rewards program but I didn’t know there was a limit on how much rewards you could receive ? Now I’m not sure when I’ll get the rewards again so I’m buying pet food that are cheaper and I don’t see any difference in my pets because they seem to like the other brands!

reviews.title: Receipts are difficult to upload
reviews.text: I enjoy what the app has to offer; however, it’s really difficult to upload receipts from Walmart online orders. They are constantly rejected and you can’t get a real person to help with a review for approval. They need to change what’s required on an online Walmart receipt because all of the info is not always possible to get a screenshot of the way Walmart app is set up. It’s frustrating because I spend a lot of $ on all Purina items for my 2 dogs and 3 stray cats I take care of and rely on cashing in points for coupons.

reviews.title: Updates, missing points, missing toys/ products - NO RESPONSE’S
reviews.text: I can’t even keep up with the updates taking up all the space on my phone on my tablet that isn’t the newest device. I never received ANYTHING but 2 free gems - my points disappear- wasn’t told - spent points on products and toys that used to be available- NOTHING RECEIVED. NO RESPOSE NO MATTER HOW MANY TIMES I EMAILED. Now I can’t and haven’t been able to even get on due to the latest update which was months ago. WASTE OF TIME UNLESS YOU HAVE TOBS OF SPACE AND THE NEWEST DEVICES AND DONT MIND GETTING MESSED OVER

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: Website in a foreign language and "unexpected error messages" galore.

reviews.title: False Advertising
reviews.text: If I could have given zero stars I would have. I cashed in 4000 of my points to receive the $20 ProPlan dog food coupon. I receive it in the mail and it can only be used on the AdvantEdge Digestive System line. At no place in the list under reward choices does it state it can only be used on that specific line when selecting that reward. If I could attach the screenshot of what it lists in description I would.

reviews.title: Disappearing points
reviews.text: The app itself works perfectly fine, it’s just ridiculous that your points expire. I had thousands of points and hadn’t used them in the next time I login they’re gone. As soon as I realize that was happening, I deleted the app

reviews.title: Crash after crash
reviews.text: I tried this app after creating an account. Tried uploading receipts with countless errors. Then the app crashed and logged me out. Then errors on every login… Outside of installing malware, what could be worse?

reviews.title: Unhappy
reviews.text: Loved the app. My 7 fur babies loved the food. You decide to do an update and now my phone is TOO OLD for update???  Lost all my points???  So disappointed 😿😿😢

reviews.title: Coupons don’t work
reviews.text: When I first started using the app, although I had many issues, I was still able to redeem points get coupons and use them at the stores. The last several times I redeemed my points for Coupons , all the stores I go to basically won’t accept them. It’s embarrassing ,if the Store does agree to accept them, they usually have to manually put the coupon in. It won’t just scan like they used to it. Kind of defeats the whole point of the app if you’re supposed to redeem your points for Coupons, but the coupons don’t work.

reviews.title: What use to be….
reviews.text: Been a long time customer and started using your Purina app a few years ago and have found it helpful when in times it didn’t always seem possible to feed your pet well in this economy. But, recently you have made it near impossible to get the coupons for my regular Purina one that I have been led to believe was always a good and affordable food. Recently, all your different brands have become extremely expensive and that is what you’re now issuing coupons for.. I don’t think it’s right. I’ve called into customer service and I’ve tried to get some help, but apparently that is the way you’re going these days  disappointing

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text:
I was disappointed with the MyPurina Pet Rewards app. I signed up after seeing what appeared to be an offer for a free Fancy Feast Gems sample, but the experience felt misleading and I did not feel that the advertised free sample was clearly explained or delivered as expected.

I’m also concerned about how much personal information the app collects and how that data may be used. The combination of a promotional offer and extensive data collection made the experience feel more like a data-collection exercise than a genuine free-sample promotion.

Purina should make the terms of promotions much clearer and be transparent about what data is collected, why it is collected, and how it is used. I would recommend reading the offer and privacy terms carefully before signing up.

reviews.title: Garbage Rewards
reviews.text: This app is very easy to earn points with and I haven’t had issues uploading receipts. However, there’s nothing to work for when it comes to those points. The rewards are actual garbage. It’s been 3+ months and there hasn’t been an update for new rewards. That last batch of reared was a bunch of ugly tshirts….people want practical items. Things like automatic feeders and litter maintaining items would be so much better than a 5,000 point ugly sweatshirt that has dogs on it…like actually be fr. when i joined the app, there was a 7k reward I wanted and was willing to save for, by the time I reached the needed points the reward was gone and replaced by the tshirts, those shirts have since come and went and there still hasn’t been an update to rewards. There are also cat food/dog food coupons that ONLY WORK WHEN ORDERING THROUGH THE APP!!!!! Stupid!!! I order through chewy so those give me absolutely nothing. There quite literally isn’t a single reward that’s worth it so you just end up sitting on 10k points for months and months and months.

reviews.title: Should be called the cat rewards app!
reviews.text:
The app itself is a great idea. Unfortunately it is USELESS unless you have a cat. They constantly offer promos & bonuses for cat only products. They also offer multiple cat toys & rewards for points yet dogs remain with zero options. They have a couple weak options for small dogs but not over 50 pounds. The one time I saw a large dog option I clicked it & as soon as I clicked redeem points the page went blank & never loaded. I contacted support & Nicole said “oh, I’m not sure what happened” 

so, if you have cats this is a great option for you. If you are like me & have large dogs that you spend way too much on don’t expect Purina to offer you any rewards for your loyalty. 

If you have a cat you can rack up a bunch of bonuses. I have redeemed points that were going to expire on cat items that I simply donate. Otherwise my points would expire & I’d have nothing. If you have large dogs this app is basically useless to you. 

Don’t waste your storage space on your phone. This app should be called the Purina Cat Rewards App. When it comes to dogs just skip it.

reviews.title: Ghosted after Winning Petivity Tracker
reviews.text: Very disappointing app. Half of the valid receipts get denied. But the biggest thing is that I was notified about winning a petivity tracker. I completed the form within the sett time window. For weeks I didn’t hear anything. I messaged support and they said they would get back to me. Nothing. I replied that I was checking in and haven’t heard anything since. This was a few months ago now. Either the Google Docs submission doesn’t actually work or there is an issue internally. Either way I did what I was suppose to and didn’t actually get the tracker. Now I’m questioning if there giveaways are actually real.

reviews.title: Bad Service
reviews.text: Similar to other reviews, I can verify that you will most likely be in contact with customer service at least once, as I have reached out at least 3 times. Although this appears to be a great way to give back to clients, that is quickly overshadowed by the fact that you may not get the guaranteed bonus points for certain items, your receipt could be declined for miscellaneous reasons, or better yet, you might have to argue with customer service for weeks to get a rewards product (that they originally lied about shipping out.) As a vet student & pet owner that only feeds Purina, I wanted to love this app, but the hassle of constantly reaching out to customer service is too much. Sadly, I won’t be recommending this to clients because, despite being a potentially fun way for consumers to be involved in Purina, it has turned into a poorly reviewed/managed scam.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: It used to be that I would occasionally have issues with loading of receipt, but for the last six months or so, I can’t get the system to recognize that I have Purina products on my receipt. The items are clearly marked as Purina. I’ve got the date in time and the store on the receipt yet. I constantly get the receipts. Kicked back with the message that there aren’t any Purina products on the receipt. I’ve even underline things pointed arrows to the products, etc.. And still I cannot get the receipts excepted. Also, they used to offer better gift cards such as Starbucks for your points but they haven’t done that in a long time. I also have a large dog and it seems like most the toys that they offer are small or medium. I lost over 15,000 points in my account because they expired because quite frankly there wasn’t anything that I wanted to get. However, it’s still frustrating to lose that many points. Now I can’t even accumulate points. Cause it won’t read my receipts

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Support
reviews.text:
I had previously received discount coupons and coupons for free treats without issue. However, the last time that I redeemed points for what was supposed to be a $10 off coupon, I received an oddly worded coupon that says it’s for a FREE 5 lb or larger bag of dry dog food, up to $10. Well, there is no such thing as a 5 lb bag of Purina dry dog food that costs ten dollars or less. It wouldn’t scan at the register and the cashier understandably wouldn’t override it because, by the letter of the coupon itself, it didn’t apply to the purchase that I was making.

When I contacted myPurina customer service to request the correct coupon (which I have received in the past and simply says SAVE $10) they tried to tell me that it actually is a coupon for a $10 discount, despite what it says. When I reiterated that the coupon was not accepted, their response was that it’s the store’s prerogative to accept or decline coupons and that I needed to go to a different store.

Also, when I check the rewards in the app, this coupon is not among them. There is the same coupon for dry CAT food though. My suspicion is that the coupon was a mistake but they’re unwilling to acknowledge that and too cheap to replace it because they make their coupons unnecessarily fancy (they’re on cardstock and have a shiny, holographic foil strip- truly eye roll worthy). Give it a year and I guarantee that they won’t be so fancy- if they’re even still supporting the app by then.

reviews.title: COUPONS NOT SENT/CUSTOMER SERVICE UNHELPFUL
reviews.text: After a few successful deliveries of rewards I’ve redeemed by saving up points, I decided I’d save up for the $10 coupon reward. I redeemed it NOVEMBER 8, 2025. I have not received it. Even after emailing Micah, JP, and Bryan (5+ emails), I still have not received anything. I heard them out for FIVE months, with them allegedly shipping out 3 coupons 3 separate times. The last email was passive aggressively offering a “one-time courtesy” accusing me of being at fault “due to your failure to provide accurate delivery information.” If true, they would’ve sent the “courtesy” coupons #2 and #3, right? I have so many points and fear using them on anything that needs to be shipped due to their complete incompetence. Only benefit to all this is that my cats have stopped eating dry food, which their vet is very happy with. Stick to feeding your pets real food! Their organs and QOL will thank you :-)

reviews.title: Glitchy and nearly unusable
reviews.text: Pet food is expensive, so I want to get reward points when I can. But this app is not intuitive or responsive - I’ve tried to cancel autoships or update shipping dates and it gets “hung” so I have to email customer service.  The price shown for my autoship is often completely wrong (double what the cost should be). When I log in to my account on a desktop browser, none of my info is present, like the app doesn’t communicate with my main account. I am running the current iOS. This app is very disappointing.
